questions.question: Who has been named by the Assembly of Experts as the new Supreme Leader of Iran?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mojtaba Khamenei.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Assembly of Experts has named Mojtaba Khamenei as the new Supreme Leader of Iran.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Appointment:** Mojtaba Khamenei, aged 56, succeeds his father, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, following the latter's assassination.
 
• **Support:** The new leader received immediate backing from the **Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC)** and the Iranian armed forces.
 
• **Regional Context:** This transition occurs during a period of high regional tension involving conflict with Israel and the United States.
 
• **Other Key Figures:** While Mojtaba Khamenei is the Supreme Leader, **Masoud Pezeshkian** remains the President, and **Ali Larijani** continues as the secretary of the Supreme National Security Council.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Assembly of Experts__

 __
 
• An 88-member deliberative body of clerics responsible for appointing and overseeing the Supreme Leader of Iran.
 
 
 
• Supreme Leader__
 
 
• The highest-ranking political and religious authority in the Islamic Republic of Iran, with the final say on all major state matters.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the next Vice Chief of the Army Staff (VCOAS) of the Indian Army, effective from April 1, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth, currently the Southern Army Commander, has been appointed as the next Vice Chief of the Army Staff (VCOAS) effective April 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Current Role:** He is presently the General Officer Commanding-in-Chief (GOC-in-C) of the **Southern Command** based in Pune.
 
• **Succession:** He will succeed **Lt Gen P.P. Singh**, who is moving to head the **Western Command**.
 
• **Experience:** An Armoured Corps officer, he has previously commanded the XXI Strike Corps and the South Western Command.
 
• **Responsibilities:** As VCOAS, he will be the second-highest ranking officer in the Army, overseeing operational preparedness and modernization at Army HQ, New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Army Command Structure__

 __
 
• The Indian Army is divided into seven commands (6 operational and 1 training). The Southern Command is the largest in terms of geographical area.
 
 
 
• VCOAS (Vice Chief of the Army Staff)__
 
 
• A three-star rank officer (Lieutenant General) who assists the Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) in strategic and administrative functions.

questions.question: In March 2026, Jose Antonio Kast was sworn in as the President of which country?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chile.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Jose Antonio Kast was officially sworn in as the President of Chile at the National Congress in Valparaiso.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Succession:** He succeeds **Gabriel Boric** as the head of state.
 
• **Political Party:** Kast is the founder of the **Republican Party** (established in 2019) and is known for his far-right political stance.
 
• **Election Victory:** He won the presidency in a runoff election held in December 2025, defeating the left-wing candidate **Jeannette Jara**.
 
• **Policy Stance:** His administration is expected to focus on **tough security measures**, strict immigration control, and conservative social policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Chilean Presidency__

 
 
• The President of Chile is both the head of state and head of government. The term of office is **four years**, and immediate re-election is not permitted under the current constitution.

questions.question: Who has become the first woman in India to be appointed as the Chief Superintendent of a functional nuclear power plant?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**RM Nachammai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **RM Nachammai made history on March 15, 2026, by becoming the first woman Chief Superintendent of an operational nuclear power plant in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **She assumed charge of Kaiga Generating Station Units 3 & 4 in Karnataka.**
 
• **The facility is managed by the Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd (NPCIL).**
 
• **In her role, she oversees the Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering Support divisions of the reactor complex.**
 
• **Kaiga Units 3 & 4 are Pressurised Heavy Water Reactors (PHWRs) with a capacity of 220 MW each.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• NPCIL__

 __
 
• A Public Sector Undertaking under the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), responsible for the design, construction, and operation of nuclear power reactors.
 
 
 
• Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR)__
 __
 
• A nuclear power reactor that uses unenriched natural uranium as its fuel and heavy water ($D_2O$) as its coolant and moderator.
 
 
 
• Kaiga Generating Station__
 
 
• Located in the Uttara Kannada district of Karnataka, it is one of India's major nuclear power generation hubs.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as Maharashtra’s first woman Deputy Chief Minister, and whom did she succeed in this position?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunetra Pawar, succeeding Ajit Pawar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Sunetra Pawar took oath as Maharashtra’s first woman Deputy Chief Minister, succeeding her husband Ajit Pawar, who died in a plane crash.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Sunetra Pawar, aged 62, became the first woman to hold the post of Deputy Chief Minister in Maharashtra.**
 
• She took oath at **Lok Bhavan**, with the oath administered by the **Governor of Maharashtra**.
 
• She succeeded **Ajit Pawar**, former Deputy Chief Minister, who passed away on January 28.
 
• The swearing-in ceremony was attended by Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis** and Deputy Chief Minister **Eknath Shinde**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Deputy Chief Minister__

 __
 
• The Deputy Chief Minister assists the Chief Minister in state administration.
 
• The position is not constitutionally mandated but is created based on political and administrative requirements.
 
 
 
• Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)__
 __
 
• A major political party in Maharashtra founded by Sharad Pawar.
 
• Sunetra Pawar belongs to the NCP faction allied with the BJP and Shiv Sena.
 
 
 
• Rajya Sabha__
 __
 
• The Upper House of the Indian Parliament.
 
• Members are elected by the elected members of State Legislative Assemblies.
 
 
 
• Lok Bhavan__
 
 
• An official residence and venue for government functions in Maharashtra.
 
• Used for oath-taking ceremonies and important state events.

questions.question: Who did Uday Kotak replace to become the new Chairman of Gujarat International Finance Tec-City Company Ltd. (GIFT City) in February 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Hasmukh Adhia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of Gujarat has appointed Uday Kotak, the founder of Kotak Mahindra Bank, as the Chairman of GIFT City with immediate effect on February 13, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Replacement:** Uday Kotak replaced **Dr. Hasmukh Adhia**, IAS (Retd.), who had been serving as the non-executive chairman of GIFT City since June 19, 2023.
 
• **The Appointee:** Uday Kotak is a veteran banker and the founder of Kotak Mahindra Bank. He has previously served in key advisory roles, including the chairmanship of **IL&FS** during its crisis management phase.
 
• **GIFT City:** Located in Gandhinagar, it is India’s first operational **Smart City** and **International Financial Services Centre (IFSC)**.
 
• **Significance:** The appointment of a private-sector stalwart like Uday Kotak is seen as a strategic move to further enhance GIFT City’s global competitiveness and attract international financial institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Dr. Hasmukh Adhia__

 __
 
• A retired IAS officer of the 1981 batch, Dr. Adhia formerly served as the **Union Finance Secretary** and Revenue Secretary. He remains the Principal Advisor to the Chief Minister of Gujarat.
 
 
 
• GIFT City Authority (IFSCA)__
 
 
• While GIFT City is the developer, the regulatory body for the financial center is the **International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA)**, currently chaired by K. Rajaraman.

questions.question: Following the resignation of Pieter Elbers in March 2026, who has taken over as the interim CEO of IndiGo?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Bhatia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers resigned with immediate effect on March 10, 2026, and Founder Rahul Bhatia has assumed the role of interim CEO.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leadership Change:** Rahul Bhatia, the **Managing Director and Founder** of InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo), took over the top executive role to stabilize the airline.
 
• **Reason for Resignation:** Pieter Elbers stepped down following a major **operational collapse in December 2025**, which saw over 5,000 flight cancellations.
 
• **Crisis Factor:** The disruption was largely attributed to **crew shortages** linked to the implementation of new **Flight Duty Time Limitations (FDTL)** rules.
 
• **Regulatory Impact:** The incident led to significant scrutiny from the **Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)** regarding the airline's operational management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation Ltd)__

 __
 
• Founded in - 2006
 
• Headquarters - Gurgaon, Haryana
 
• It is India's largest passenger airline by market share.
 
 
 
• Flight Duty Time Limitations (FDTL)__
 __
 
• Regulations set by the DGCA to ensure pilots and cabin crew get adequate rest to prevent fatigue-related safety risks.
 
 
 
• DGCA (Directorate General of Civil Aviation)__
 
 
• The statutory body of the Government of India to regulate civil aviation in India. It primarily deals with safety issues.

• Safeguard environment and public health

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Director General of the National Investigation Agency (NIA) in January 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rakesh Aggarwal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh cadre IPS officer Rakesh Aggarwal has been appointed as the new Director General of the National Investigation Agency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rakesh Aggarwal is a 1994 batch Indian Police Service officer of the Himachal Pradesh cadre.**
 
• He will serve as Director General of the NIA until August 31, 2028, the date of his superannuation.
 
• Before this appointment, he was serving as the Special Director General of the NIA.
 
• His appointment was approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet on the proposal of the Ministry of Home Affairs.

• Indian Police Service__
 __

• IPS officers can be deputed to central agencies like NIA and CBI.
 
 
 
• Appointments Committee of the Cabinet__
 __
 
• A committee of the Union Cabinet that approves appointments to top government posts.
 
• It cleared Rakesh Aggarwal’s appointment as DG of NIA.
 
 
 
• Rakesh Aggarwal__
 
 
• Born on August 5, 1968, in Haryana.
 
• He has served as ADG of NIA, Joint Director of CBI and Director General of Home Guards in Himachal Pradesh.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Balendra Shah seen in news in March 2026:

1. He is the 47th and youngest Prime Minister in Nepal's history.

2. He is the first person from the Madhes region to hold the post.

3. His party, the Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP), was formed in 2012.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 2 only.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Balendra Shah was sworn in as the 47th Prime Minister of Nepal on March 27, 2026, following a historic election win.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct: At 35 years old, Balendra Shah is the youngest person to ever hold the top executive post in Nepal.**
 
• Statement 2 is correct: He has made history by becoming the first Prime Minister hailing from the Madhes region (southern plains) of Nepal.
 
• Statement 3 is incorrect: The Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) was formed recently in 2022, not 2012.
 
• Balendra Shah (Balen)__
 __
 
• Age - 35 years
 
• Background - Rapper and Engineer
 
• Party - Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Election Performance__

 __
 
• The RSP secured 182 out of 275 seats in the House of Representatives during the March 5 elections.
 
 
 
• Jhapa-5 Constituency__
 __
 
• Balendra Shah defeated veteran leader K.P. Sharma Oli in this stronghold by a margin of nearly 50,000 votes.
 
 
 
• Political Shift__
 
 
• The rise of RSP represents a shift toward tech-savvy and anti-corruption focused governance in Nepal.

questions.question: Who has been given the additional charge of being the Governor of Tamil Nadu after RN Ravi was transferred to West Bengal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Significant changes were made to the gubernatorial positions of West Bengal and Tamil Nadu in March 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar, the current Governor of Kerala, will now additionally discharge the functions of the Governor of Tamil Nadu.**
 
• **This decision comes after RN Ravi was moved from Tamil Nadu to serve as the Governor of West Bengal.**
 
• **The reshuffle followed the acceptance of the resignation of Dr. C.V. Ananda Bose as the Governor of West Bengal.**
 
• **Article 153 allows for the same person to be appointed as Governor for two or more States.**

• Provided for the appointment of a single Governor for two or more states.

questions.question: Who was elected President of Guinea in December 2025 after ruling the country since the 2021 military coup?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mamady Doumbouya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Mamady Doumbouya, Guinea’s military leader since the September 2021 coup, was elected President in December 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Doumbouya assumed power following a military coup in September 2021 that overthrew Alpha Condé, Guinea’s first freely elected President.**
 
• The December 2025 election was conducted amid a boycott by major opposition parties and restrictions on political freedoms.
 
• Under the new Constitution of September 2025, junta members were allowed to contest elections, and the presidential term was extended from 5 to 7 years, renewable once.
 
• Doumbouya secured 86.72% of the votes, avoiding a runoff, while official voter turnout was reported at 80.95%, disputed by opposition groups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Mamady Doumbouya__

 __
 
• Leader of the Guinea military junta since 2021.
 
• Former Special Forces commander before leading the coup against Alpha Condé.
 
• His election marks the formal transition from military rule to a civilian presidency under junta leadership.
 
 
 
• Alpha Condé__
 __
 
• First freely elected President of Guinea, overthrown in the 2021 military coup.
 
• His presidency saw political tensions and eventual displacement by the military.
 
 
 
• West African Military Transitions__
 __
 
• Similar military-led transitions have occurred in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger.
 
• These events raise concerns about democratic governance and stability in the region.
 
 
 
• Constitutional Changes__
 
 
• The September 2025 Constitution allowed military junta members to contest elections and extended the presidential term from 5 to 7 years.
 
• These changes facilitated Doumbouya’s candidacy and election victory.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Lieutenant Governor of Delhi following the gubernatorial reshuffle announced on March 6, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Taranjit Singh Sandhu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu approved a major reshuffle of Governors and Lieutenant Governors across several States and UTs on March 6, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taranjit Singh Sandhu, a former diplomat, has been appointed as the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi.**
 
• **He succeeds Vinai Kumar Saxena, who has been reassigned as the Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh.**
 
• **The appointment is part of a broader realignment of constitutional heads in various states and Union Territories.**
 
• **The President of India makes these appointments under Article 155 (for Governors) and Article 239 (for LGs/Administrators).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Vinai Kumar Saxena__

 __
 
• Former LG of Delhi; Now appointed as LG of Ladakh.
 
 
 
• Kavinder Gupta__
 __
 
• Former LG of Ladakh; Now appointed as Governor of Himachal Pradesh.
 
 
 
• RN Ravi__
 __
 
• Former Governor of Tamil Nadu; Now appointed as Governor of West Bengal.
 
 
 
• Constitutional Role__
 
 
• Lieutenant Governors are the constitutional heads of Union Territories, appointed by the President.
